responsibility: Implements the multi-pass gm2 compilation driver. It preprocesses and examines the initial compilation unit, discovers and queues imported modules, associates module symbols with source files, then repeatedly opens sources through `M2LexBuf` and runs pass 0, pass 1, pass 2, aggregate-constant pass C, pass 3, and final GCC tree generation via `M2Code`, while tracking current module kind and handling special hidden-type parsing, preprocessing-only mode, and whole-program import behavior.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the working implementation of the M2Comp compilation driver: it manages `ModuleType`, examines the initial unit, queues and associates modules via `M2Batch`, runs passes 0/1/2/C/3/4, and handles hidden-type and whole-program cases that `M2Comp.def` only presents through a small API.
